parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The execution interval between each batch of the scheduled prefetch plan, in seconds.

parameters.name: SliceLen
parameters.description: The number of URLs to prefetch per batch.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the scheduled prefetch plan, in ISO 8601 format (such as 2024-01-01T00:00:00+Z).
